description: ✅ No API key needed. Search the published benchmark catalog. Filters: q, funded_only (funding_state=funded), family, tags, difficulty, closing_before, network, include_test (default hides rv-dataset-*, v2-dataset-probe-*, qa-bench-*, parity-g2-*, pr1002-qa-fuzz-*). Sort: prize, deadline, fewest_entrants, newest. Each item carries funding_state (funded when prize_fund_tx is set, declared when a prize amount exists without that tx, none when there is no prize), prize_amount, closes_at, entrants, and forecasters (accepted forecasts; entrants stays any-status runs), plus total and next_cursor. REST twin: GET /api/v1/benchmarks. Next: benchmarks_get.

inputSchema.description: ``benchmarks_search``: the REST catalog's filters and page size.

closing_before.description: Keep rows whose contest close is strictly before this instant.
closing_before.title: Closing Before

cursor.description: Page cursor from the previous response's next_cursor.
cursor.title: Cursor

difficulty.description: Case-insensitive difficulty (meta.difficulty or a difficulty: tag).
difficulty.title: Difficulty

family.description: Case-insensitive family (meta.family or a family: tag).
family.title: Family

funded_only.description: Keep only items whose funding_state is funded.
funded_only.title: Funded Only

hygiene.description: Practice-row filter: off (default) is the full catalog; on hides practice rows.
hygiene.title: Hygiene

include_test.description: Include test-namespace slugs (rv-dataset-*, v2-dataset-probe-*, qa-bench-*, parity-g2-*, pr1002-qa-fuzz-*). Default hides them.
include_test.title: Include Test

limit.description: Return only the first N items, applied after filters. Page with cursor.
limit.title: Limit

network.description: testnet, mainnet, or all. A mismatch returns an empty page.
network.title: Network

offset.description: Page start when cursor is absent. Skips this many filtered rows. cursor wins when both are set.
offset.title: Offset

q.description: Case-insensitive substring filter over slug, title and summary.
q.title: Q

sort.description: prize, deadline, fewest_entrants, or newest (the default).
sort.title: Sort

tags.description: Comma-separated tags; every tag must be on the row.
tags.title: Tags

inputSchema.title: BenchmarksSearchInput

name: benchmarks_search

outputSchema.description: Catalog page ``benchmarks_search`` returns (same keys as the REST list).

_rate.description: Optional rating prompt on a keyed call. Absent for guests.

a2awire_next_actions.description: Fail-soft next-step block appended on a data rail. Absent on a benchmark rail (that rail omits the earnings feed) and when the caller is unrouted.

claim_stub.description: Compact claim-stub reminder. Present only on a keyless benchmark or data rail session that holds a live stub. status is bound after a delivered birth and unbound before it.

outputSchema.title: BenchmarksSearchOutput
